families.label: Modal Transportation Operations
families.definition: Scheduled or network-scale operation of air, rail, maritime, postal, package, and leased commercial transportation assets and services.

capabilities.label: Airline operations
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate scheduled or network air passenger and cargo service with integrated fleet, crew, safety, airport, and customer systems.

capabilities.label: Rail transportation operations
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate freight or passenger rail networks, rolling stock, terminals, schedules, safety systems, and supporting infrastructure.

capabilities.label: Maritime freight transportation
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate vessels and related terminal or network systems for commercial movement of containerized, bulk, or specialized freight by water.

capabilities.label: Package and postal delivery operations
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate integrated acceptance, sortation, linehaul, tracking, customs, and final-delivery networks for mail and parcels.

capabilities.label: Commercial vehicle leasing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to acquire, lease, rent, maintain, replace, and administer commercial vehicles or fleets for business customers.

families.label: Wholesale Distribution
families.definition: Acquisition, stocking, sale, fulfillment, and channel distribution of goods to retailers, institutions, businesses, and other non-consumer buyers.

capabilities.label: Diversified wholesale distribution
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to source, stock, sell, fulfill, and distribute a broad assortment of products to business, institutional, or retail-channel buyers.

capabilities.label: Electronics and office equipment wholesale distribution
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to source, stock, configure, sell, fulfill, and distribute electronics, computing, communications, or office equipment through wholesale channels.

capabilities.label: Food and grocery wholesale distribution
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to source, store, sell, fulfill, and distribute food, beverage, grocery, and related products to retail or food-service buyers.

capabilities.label: Healthcare product wholesale distribution
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to source, store, sell, trace, fulfill, and distribute pharmaceuticals, medical products, or healthcare supplies to authorized buyers.
